name: @truenine/memory-sync-mcp
description: TrueNine Memory Sync MCP metadata package
author: TrueNine

scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path Cargo.toml && cargo run --manifest-path Cargo.toml --bin memory-sync-mcp -- assemble-npm --profile release
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && pnpm run check
